products.what_it_changes: Seller: Ti-6Al-4V TIG-welded, 60 mm (2.4in) wide platform, 30 teeth per peg, about 175 g per peg / 350 g per set, roughly half the weight of stock steel pegs.
rider_feedback: MXA team test of Pro-Pegs titanium pegs (https://motocrossactionmag.com/amp/mxa-team-tested-pro-pegs-titanium-footpegs; compared against a stock Yamaha YZ125 peg, $268 per pair): 'every test rider was pleased with how much grip the Pro-Pegs provided'; about 6 oz per peg vs 8.4 oz stock, 60 mm vs 55 mm, 29 teeth vs 20; negatives: 'The support brackets underneath the footpegs are scooped' and 'Even the most sensitive testers didn't notice the weight savings'.
products.caveats: GasGas 2023 MC models fall under MSPPMX0089 per the seller list even though KTM/Husqvarna 2023 MX models take MSPPMX0090; confirm against the bike's peg mount. 2025+ not listed.
